# Events

*Things that happen that nobody chose.*

## What this covers

Events is the home for things that happen to the world without being initiated as an ordinary action by a nation. Its dedicated design round has not yet been completed, so the wiki does not yet treat Events as a finished standalone system. This page should grow as those rules are decided rather than filling the gap in advance.
